nodes.label: Banned UI Patterns
nodes.rationale: Every listed item is what AI-generated UI does by default. If it feels like the AI default, it is. Pick the harder, cleaner option. When in doubt, ask what Linear would do.

nodes.label: Banned Layout Patterns
nodes.rationale: Prefer a fixed sidebar, a plain page header, content-first layout, a predictable grid, and consistent 24-32px padding. Floating shells, dashboard heroes, default metric grids, decorative rails, and one long mobile scroll are the AI default.

nodes.label: Banned Component Patterns
nodes.rationale: Prefer solid panels, shadow at most 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 6-10px radii, solid or outlined buttons, a simple focus ring, labels above fields, and fade-only modals. Glass, pills, gradients, sliding tabs, zebra stripes, and status dots via ::before are banned.

nodes.label: Banned Typography Patterns
nodes.rationale: Use one typeface family and direct headings. Eyebrow labels, tracked uppercase everywhere, gradient text, mixed serif and sans, decorative copy, and Segoe UI, Trebuchet MS, or Arial are banned.

nodes.label: Banned Colour Patterns
nodes.rationale: Use solid colours from a chosen palette. Soft gradients, blue-black premium dark mode, cyan accents on dark blue, glows, decorative conic gradients, gradient borders, and random colour combinations are banned. Random combinations should be replaced by a pick from colour-palettes.md.

nodes.label: True Dark Colours
nodes.rationale: Replace blue-black gradient premium dark mode with true dark #0f172a and #1e293b so dark UI stays flat and readable.

nodes.label: Banned Motion Patterns
nodes.rationale: Motion should be a background-colour change or 100-200ms ease, or no animation. Hover translate, bounce, card scale, and page-load entrance animations are banned because they draw attention without helping the task.

nodes.label: Hard-No HTML Patterns
nodes.rationale: Eyebrow-plus-headline, small-label-plus-strong-note, nav badges, gradient brand blocks, and a KPI grid as the default dashboard are hard no. They are recognizable AI chrome rather than product UI.

nodes.label: Linear Benchmark
nodes.rationale: When a UI choice is uncertain, match what Linear would do: strict, readable, and free of decorative chrome.
